Core genomic analysis functions for diploid and polyploid breeding programs.

### BIGapp

A user-friendly Shiny application for genomic analysis without requiring command-line workflows.

<div class="meta-row"><span class="pill">R Shiny</span><span class="pill">GWAS + GS</span></div>

[Explore BIGapp](software/bigapp.qmd){.card-link}

### Qploidy2

Ploidy, aneuploidy, and large-scale copy-number estimation from genotyping data.

<div class="meta-row"><span class="pill">R package</span><span class="pill">Ploidy + CNV</span></div>
